topic.title: Market Structure: Higher Highs, Lower Lows, and Real Direction

research.summary: A simple starting point is to track swing highs and swing lows. A sequence of higher highs and higher lows can show upward structure, while lower highs and lower lows can show downward structure. But structure can change. Do not force a trend label onto every chart; wait for price to confirm what it is actually doing.
